content.short: Web3 Modal is a simple Web3 wallet management library.
content.description: Web3 Modal is an open-source library for managing wallet connections, affiliated with Wallet Connect. It provides a smooth, user-friendly interface that helps users easily navigate and connect their wallets with external apps or Web3-native websites. Unlike many Web3 frontend libraries, Web3 Modal does not constrain developers to a single framework; Vue, Angular, and Vanilla JS are also supported, in addition to React, allowing flexible integration across different projects.
